evidence.title: ChebBooster: A Training-Free Approach for Efficient Diffusion Transformer Inference via Chebyshev-Inspired Extrapolation

summary: Researchers introduced ChebBooster, a training-free technique that accelerates diffusion transformer inference by applying Chebyshev-inspired extrapolation to model activations. The approach delivers substantial speedups without extra training, improving efficiency for diffusion‑based AI generation tasks.
title: ChebBooster Enables Training-Free, Faster Diffusion Transformer Inference Using Chebyshev Extrapolation
